{{Top|leg}}
[[Yevetha]]n '''breederies''' were places reserved for elite Yevetha. A Yevetha's mates would live in these breederies, waiting until they had their child. [[Nil Spaar]], the Yevetha's ''[[darama]]'', had a massive breedery during his tenure as head of the [[Duskhan League]]. Most breederies on Yevetha were destroyed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="SOL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>
